top_categories.workout_context: 77 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 77 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant. Train it until it feels boring.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
At Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 77 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.heat: Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant’s 77 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gran Fondo Mont-Tremblant requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 77 miles of mixed terrain in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec, Canada.
